submission_checklist: A demo video (public on YouTube, under 3 minutes) showing your Lens working in the Lens Studio preview.
A repository on GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket (public or private; if private, shared with specified emails before the deadline) including Lens Studio project files and the devpost/ planning folder.
A short description explaining what your Lens does, who it's for, and what you learned.
notes: This is Round 2 of Learn AR with SPECS.
No SPECS glasses are required; everything runs in Lens Studio's preview on your laptop.
Projects must be planned with the Devpost Learn skill pack and built with CLAD in Lens Studio.
